institutionName: UiT The Arctic University of Norway

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer:
I wanted to go to a place where it would be possible to enjoy winter activities. Furthermore go to a place where I could make a connection and wanted to come back and I thought that Norway was the place. 

I wanted to explore the land and the beautiful nature which was also crucial for the choosing process.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Enjoy the nature, enjoy the easy go around with bus and go from winter to summer it is easy to adjust from dark to light than the other way around. 
Enjoy the slow living.
